source_selection.selection_rationale: first preregistered Experiment-1 confirmation seed; selected by ID rather than an observed burstiness, collision, freshness, or transport outcome

transport_baseline.rationale: Freeze the previously live-qualified OAI+srsRAN multi-UE slice path and match the intended OAI+srsRAN N320 physical transport. The first setup-only Open5GS+srsRAN attempt exposed the known srsUE Requested-NSSAI-in-cleartext incompatibility before any Experiment-2 telemetry was replayed, so it produced no transport outcome and is not used as the experiment baseline.

pilot_objective: Find and freeze a reproducible 5G competing-traffic operating point before the matched timing confirmation campaign. Do not use this pilot to select a source trace based on transport outcomes.
transport_sequence: RFSIM competing-traffic sweep to locate the transport knee
paired native/gap_permutation/periodic pilot at the frozen point
qualify physical N320 OAI+srsRAN path before any physical confirmation runs
